High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:132031-Db

Petitioner :- Siyaram
Respondent :- State Of Up And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Aga for the State-respondents and perused the
record.

2. The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioner with the prayer to quash theFIR dated
06.07.2024 in Case Crime No.0295 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 Ipc, Police
Station Nai Mandi, District Muzaffar Nagar.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that from the allegations made in the first information report, prima facie no offence, complained of, is disclosed against the petitioner and as Siyaram vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198832560/
1 such, the impugned first information report is liable to be quashed.

entities.text: Siyaram vs State Of Up And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that from the allegations made in the first information report, prima facie offence is clearly disclosed against the petitioner, therefore, the impugned first information report can not be quashed in view of law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani reported in (2017) 2 SCC 779, Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others reported in (2021) SCC Online SC 315 and in a recent decision of the Hon'ble Apex Court in Criminal Appeal No. 843 of 2024, Directorate Enforcement Vs. Niraj Tyagi and others.

entities.text: State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani reported in (2017) 2 SCC 779
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others reported in (2021) SCC Online SC 315
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Directorate Enforcement Vs. Niraj Tyagi and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Having considered the rival submission made by learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the allegations made in the FIR and the relevant law cited by learned AGA and the fact that impugned first information report discloses cognizable offence against the petitioner, we are of the opinion that the impugned first information report can not be quashed.
6. The prayer for quashing the impugned first information report is therefore refused.

7. However in case, the petitioner moves an application for anticipatory bail/ regular bail before the appropriate court, his bail application shall be considered and disposed of as expeditiously as possible in accordance with law.
8. With the aforesaid observations, the instant writ petition is disposed of.

Order Date :- 14.8.2024 Amit  Siyaram vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198832560/
